topics.title: Google DeepMind uses Gemini 4 agent teams and Lean to optimize quantum algorithms
topics.summary: On November 23, 2026, Google DeepMind and Google Quantum AI published research showing teams of Gemini 4 agents discovered faster quantum circuits for fusion energy, chemistry, and drug-metabolizing enzymes, cutting spacetime costs up to 11.8x on fusion simulations and 290x on an arithmetic routine, with every circuit formally verified in Lean.

topics.title: OpenAI and Cisco launch Shirudo open-source eBPF runtime to shield Linux systems
topics.summary: On November 23, 2026, OpenAI and Cisco introduced Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime that deploys eBPF shields to block exploits on running servers before patches arrive or restarts occur. Combining AI-generated mitigation code with human approval and TPM 2.0 attestation, Shirudo demonstrated live blocking of a Java4Shell exploit on Elasticsearch.

topics.title: UN chief urges talks on global AI risk framework at Bridgetown safety summit
topics.summary: At the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety in Barbados on November 23, 2026, UN Secretary-General António Guterres urged member states to negotiate a multilateral AI risk management framework, warning that safety guardrails lag behind autonomous AI capabilities and calling for shared testing standards and capacity-building for developing nations.
